report.summary: Patient Hector Alvarado (P-D012, 47, Medicaid/Lakeshore Community Health Plan) lives at 4000 W North Ave, Chicago, IL 60639 (tract 17031230500, Cook County). Most recent AHC screener (2026-09-30) shows food_worry = "sometimes_true" and food_ran_out = "never_true"; no transportation/utility/housing needs flagged. He is on insulin glargine (needs refrigeration) and gabapentin with no refill gaps. Four community food resources were identified; eligibility noted where checkable from the record/resource pages.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need. No ID or eligibility screening required. Lowest-barrier option given current food worry.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM. No ID required; fresh produce available Wednesdays. Cook County location accessible to Chicago resident.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon. Eligible as a Cook County resident (Chicago address).

options.name: Westside Grocery Rescue
options.how_to_access: Requires pre-approval: submit patient MRN and medication list to the pre-approval endpoint; approved patients receive same-day help. Patient is on refrigerated insulin, so same-day grocery support may be relevant. Share identifiers only with clinic staff if pursuing.
